flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/hook/{ActionNotice,useNoticeSubmit}, pages/Furnish/hooks/useFurnishAPI. ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/manualreview/{controllers/ManualReviewController,services/ManualReviewService}. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not related
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); no separate requirement is given. A confirmation dialog with OK and close exists, and only OK calls the API; closing the dialog calls nothing and the form stays intact. What is missing: the dialog shows no message or particulars details, so the "details are wrong" reason to cancel cannot be judged from that dialog (the gap is in OCMS41.18). Confirm triggers two sequential requests with no rollback. The behaviour after cancel (return to the previous screen) is assessed in OCMS41.23.
recommendation: Claim confirm and cancel. Record that the dialog is a one-sentence question and that confirm triggers two requests without rollback

steps.step: The officer confirms the send and update action
steps.detail: The OK button on ModalConfirm (ActionNotice.tsx:381-386) calls onComModalOk, which closes the dialog and runs onSaveSubmit when caseType is SUBMIT (lines 313-317), and onSaveSubmit calls Notice.Submit(form) (lines 240-243) which runs approve and then compose (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:191-232).

steps.step: The officer cancels the action if the displayed details are incorrect
steps.detail: ModalConfirm onClose only sets the modalCom.show state to false (ActionNotice.tsx:381-386); no API call is made and the form and compose_list stay as they were, so the officer can correct them. Note: the dialog holds a one-sentence question (ActionNotice.tsx:189-200), so the officer judges "details wrong" from the Reply tab and the decision tab, not from the dialog.

steps.step: Confirming triggers sending the SMS/email and updating the particulars together
steps.detail: After OK, approve-hirer/approve-driver is called first; compose to send-email/send-sms is called only when approve succeeds and the checkbox and compose_list are filled (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:198-216). Two separate requests with no rollback: if sending fails the particulars are already saved (lines 218-221). Same fact as OCMS41.17 step 4.
